title: 青玉案（凌波不过横塘路）
titleEn: The Green Jade Table (She Never Came Past Hengtang Road)
author: 贺铸
intro: A man watches a beautiful woman walk past without coming his way, and spends the evening wondering about her. How much sorrow does he feel? As much as misty grass, flying catkins and the endless rains of early summer.
analysis: 这首词写一次没有结果的相思。上阕：一位美丽的女子轻盈地走过，却没有走到横塘路这边来，他只能目送她远去。“凌波”是形容女子步子轻盈，好像走在水波上。他想：她美好的青春年华和谁一起度过呢？是在月下的小桥、开满花的院子，还是在雕花的窗户、朱红的门后？大概只有春天知道。下阕写傍晚：云慢慢飘过长满香草的水边，他提笔写下伤心的句子。最后一问一答是全词最有名的地方：要问我的闲愁有多少？就像满河的烟雾笼罩的青草，满城飞舞的柳絮，梅子黄熟时下个不停的雨。用三个景物来比喻愁，愁变得看得见、摸得着，又多又乱又绵长。贺铸也因此得了“贺梅子”的外号。
analysisEn: This is a lyric about longing that goes nowhere. In the first half, a lovely woman passes by with light steps — “skimming the waves”, a phrase borrowed from an old poem about a river goddess — but she never comes along Hengtang Road, where he is, and he can only watch the dust behind her. Who, he wonders, will share her beautiful years? Is she by a moonlit bridge, in a flowering courtyard, behind carved windows and a red door? Only spring knows. The second half moves to evening: clouds drift slowly over the fragrant shore, and he picks up his brush to write heartbroken lines. Then comes the famous ending, a question and three answers. How much idle sorrow do I have? A whole river of misty grass, a whole city of wind-blown willow catkins, and the rain that falls when the plums turn yellow. Three images make an invisible feeling visible — vast, tangled and endless — and they are all images of late spring and early summer in the south. The last line was so admired that people nicknamed the poet “He of the Plums”.
background: He Zhu (1052–1125), a descendant of an empress’s family, held minor military and civil posts and was known for his forthright character. In his later years he retired to Suzhou, where Hengtang, mentioned in this lyric, is a place name.
pronunciation: 词牌“青玉案”的“案”读 àn。“谁与度”的“与”读 yǔ（和、跟）。冉冉 rǎn rǎn。蘅皋 héng gāo。琐窗 suǒ chuāng。风絮 fēng xù。“几许”的“许”读 xǔ。“知处”的“处”读 chù。
version: 采用今天最通行的文本（各种宋词选本、鉴赏辞典多用此本）。各本异文较多：“锦瑟华年”一作“锦瑟年华”；“月桥花院”一作“月台花榭”；“只有春知处”一作“惟有春知处”；“飞云冉冉”一作“碧云冉冉”；“试问闲愁都几许”一作“若问闲情都几许”或“试问闲情都几许”。维基文库所收即“锦瑟年华……月台花榭……惟有……碧云”本。

lines.py: líng bō bù guò héng táng lù
lines.lit: Skimming the waves, she does not come past Hengtang Road;
lines.en: Light as if gliding on water, she never came down Hengtang Road;

lines.py: dàn mù sòng, fāng chén qù
lines.lit: I only watch her fragrant dust go.
lines.en: I could only watch the dust of her steps drift away.

lines.py: jǐn sè huá nián shuí yǔ dù
lines.lit: Her brocade-zither years of youth — with whom spent?
lines.en: Who will share the bright years of her youth?

lines.py: yuè qiáo huā yuàn, suǒ chuāng zhū hù
lines.lit: Moonlit bridge, flowered courtyard, latticed window, red door —
lines.en: A moonlit bridge, a courtyard of flowers, a carved window, a red door —
only spring knows where she is.

lines.py: fēi yún rǎn rǎn héng gāo mù
lines.lit: Flying clouds drift slowly; evening on the fragrant shore;
lines.en: Clouds drift slowly over the fragrant shore as evening falls;

lines.py: cǎi bǐ xīn tí duàn cháng jù
lines.lit: with a colourful brush I newly write heartbreaking lines.
lines.en: with my brush I write new lines that break the heart.

lines.py: shì wèn xián chóu dōu jǐ xǔ
lines.lit: May I ask: idle sorrow, how much is it in all?
lines.en: You ask how much idle sorrow I have?

lines.py: yī chuān yān cǎo, mǎn chéng fēng xù
lines.lit: A whole river of misty grass, a whole city of wind-blown catkins,
lines.en: A whole river of grass in mist, a whole city of catkins on the wind,

lines.lit: rain at the time when plums turn yellow.
lines.en: and the rain that falls when the plums turn yellow.

words.note: 出自曹植《洛神赋》“凌波微步”，形容女子步态轻盈。
地名，作者晚年住在附近。

words.en: fragrant dust — the dust of a woman’s steps
words.note: 古词，代指美人走过的地方。
借用李商隐《锦瑟》，今天“华年”仍指青春。
与：和。今天说“和谁一起度过”。
古词，雕着连环花纹的窗。
书面语仍用，如“冉冉升起”。

words.en: a shore where fragrant herbs grow
words.note: 蘅：杜蘅，一种香草；皋：水边高地。
形容极度悲伤，今天书面语仍用。

words.en: a whole stretch (of plain or river)
words.note: 川：平野或河流，今天“川流不息”还用。

words.en: willow catkins blown by the wind
the plum rains of early summer
words.note: 江南初夏梅子黄熟时连绵的雨，今天叫“梅雨”。

imagery.name: 草
imagery.zh: “一川烟草”：满河烟雾里的青草，比喻愁绪多得望不到边。
imagery.en: A whole river of grass in mist — sorrow that stretches as far as the eye can see.

imagery.name: 柳
imagery.zh: “满城风絮”：漫天飞舞的柳絮，比喻愁绪纷乱、理不清。
imagery.en: Willow catkins whirling over the whole city — sorrow that is tangled and impossible to sort out.

imagery.name: 雨
imagery.zh: 梅雨连绵不断，比喻愁绪绵长、停不下来。
imagery.en: The plum rains go on and on — sorrow that never lets up.

imagery.name: 云
imagery.zh: 傍晚慢慢飘走的云，像远去的女子，也带出暮色里的惆怅。
imagery.en: Clouds drifting off at dusk are like the woman moving away, and bring the wistful mood of evening.
